method: Batch 89 (mobrec89): the batch 88 b88mr harness (a ticked EntityPlayerMP whose potion effects and food stats run; every EntityThrowable updates after the mobs in spawn order) where a blaze's small fireballs (EntityFireball ze) update in the same spawn-order pass. Rows as b88mr plus row element 10 [[each mob's active effects [id, duration, amplifier] by id], [player health, FoodStats foodLevel, saturation, exhaustion, foodTimer], [[fireball index, x, y, z, motion x, y, z, dead] for each one that updated]]; row element 5[1] lists a new fireball as [fireball, x, y, z, motion, Entity.rand seed] after its first update. Script ops: effect idx id ticks [amplifier]; realhp h (the player's max health back to 20, health h, and no 1000 reset after each tick); food level saturation. snow-blaze-*: a snow golem against a blaze; poison-*: poison, Poison II and regeneration on a pig, zombie, spider, witch, snow golem, iron golem and zombie pigman; player-poison*: Poison II and IV on the player (one with cave spider bites); food-*: the player's real health with natural regeneration, poison, starvation and Hunger. Unchanged classes on the VillageLiveProbe double (no village), the player a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe), every mob ticked by Entity.onUpdate. Per tick: [mob rows [x,y,z,health,target index,revenge index,flags,draws], sounds, player health lost, player revenge index, player ticks]; the player has index types.length. See EndermanWolfProbe.java for types and script ops.
